segments.dry: One reviewer with dry skin, especially in air-conditioned or dry seasons, says the moisture from this mask lasts noticeably longer than usual; another uses it specifically to lock in moisture on dry skin after microneedling.

concerns.aging: A couple of reviewers say it helps minimize the look of fine lines and leaves skin looking smoother, firmer and more youthful, crediting the PDRN and collagen-supporting ingredients.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers consistently describe it as strongly hydrating, with several saying the moisture lasts noticeably longer than the suggested wear time, including one who uses it specifically to lock in moisture after microneedling left her skin dry.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer says her skin's moisture barrier looked stronger and more even-textured after use.

extraits.texte: It’s a good mask. I have used it twice and feel that it’s hydrating. It comes with plenty of serum. It’s a thicker mask and stays hydrating longer than the suggested 20 min. My only small complaint is that the mask is huge. Bigger than any other mask I’ve tried (I’m a mask-aholic). Would be great for bigger faces. Because of the size, it does start falling off if you’re standing up.

I had no Idea what "Glass Skin" is until I saw a video from a model the other day. For me, this mask made my skin sooo youthful looking, and it had a "glass skin look" for real. Thoroughly impressed. One thing, if you have a petite face and head, it's huge!! Lol They most definitely need different sizes. Other than that, Great!! 💯

extraits.titre: My favorite high quality pdrn mask!My favorite high quality pdrn mask!
extraits.texte: I am very familiar with this brand for awhile now. I love it. I love how this sheet mask is powered by salmon DNA PDRN and c-PDRN to leave my skin looking smoother, firmer, and more radiant. It gives my complexion a refreshed, healthy-looking glow while helping improve elasticity and overall skin vitality. The blend of salmon serum and purified salmon sperm extract provides intense hydration and nourishment. My skin feels soothed, deeply moisturized, and the moisture barrier looks stronger, with a softer, more even-looking texture. I appreciate the advanced c-PDRN technology, which helps support collagen production and minimizes the appearance of fine lines. It's become one of my favorite treatments whenever my skin needs extra care or a revitalizing boost. The ultra-soft microfiber sheet fits my face comfortably and stays in place, allowing the essence to absorb well. It leaves my skin feeling calm, hydrated, and refreshed long after I remove the mask. I also like that Rejuran delivers high-quality Korean skincare that's cruelty-free and free of parabens, sulfates, and other harsh ingredients. It gives me confidence knowing I'm using a gentle, effective mask that prioritizes both skin health and safety. Good value for the money. A++ Its one of the best masks I've used. I hope my review was helpful to you. Have a lovely day!

I like to use this mask after I’ve had micro-needling done. After a micro-needling session my skin is dry for a few days so I like to use the Rejuran mask to lock in moisture. It’s also good to use just to reduce pores and give you smooth/soft skin.

extraits.titre: モチモチ肌を実感！リジュラン ターンオーバーマスクモチモチ肌を実感！リジュラン ターンオーバーマスク
extraits.texte: 肌がなんとなくゴワついてきた感じがして、話題になっていたこちらのリジュランターンオーバーマスクを使ってみました。 開けた瞬間、美容液の量がすごくてびっくりしました！ マスク自体も厚めでしっかりしているし、肌への密着感もなかなか良いです。 時間をおいて外したあとは、しっとりモチモチ。特に翌朝の肌の手触りが全然違っていて、メイクのりもよくなりました。 私は乾燥肌で、特にエアコンの季節はガサガサになりやすいのですが、これはかなり潤いが長続きしてくれて助かります。 ただ、少しだけサイズが大きめで、目元のフィット感には少し工夫が必要かもしれません。 でもその分、フェイスラインまでしっかりケアできるのが嬉しいです。 スペシャルケアとして週1～2回使うのが楽しみになってます。 贅沢な使用感なのにコスパもそこまで悪くないので、今後もリピ予定です！

extraits.titre: by far one of my favourite masks
extraits.texte: i’m a big user of collagen masks, Korean masks, glass skin masks etc. This is an absolute favourite. I used it once my skin was amazing immediately after and the following day. I could actually feel something happening, which I don’t feel when I use my other mask.

reserve: Only 12 reviews were available, all rated 4 stars or above, so this reading skews positive and may not capture drawbacks that would show up in a larger or more critical sample.
